readout_other: elevated plus-maze, open field, Morris water maze; in vivo hippocampal (dentate gyrus) fEPSP recording of LTP and depotentiation
direction_notes: Both TMAS (ultrasound plus 0.2 T static field) and ultrasound alone (TUS) improved hippocampal LTP in MPTP mice and might improve water-maze performance relative to sham; TMAS performed better than TUS. Behavioural group sizes were 3 or 4 per group.
safety_notes: PD mice were in good physical and mental state during the 10 days of treatment and showed no obvious discomfort after TMAS and TUS.

exposures.label: TUS (and TMAS with 0.2 T magnet) to substantia nigra, 1 MHz, daily for 10 days

target.label: substantia nigra of the mouse brain

timing.protocol_description: 1 MHz pulses with a stated pulse duration of "200 µm" (unit as printed, apparently a typo for a time unit) at 1 Hz PRF; 2 min per session containing 120 pulses, once daily for 10 days. The TMAS arm used the same ultrasound within a 0.2 T static magnetic field; the TUS arm removed the magnet. Mice were under 1% isoflurane.

Ispta given as 60 mW/cm2, converted to W/cm2.
Healthy n=9 and PD n=30 are group totals including sham mice; the paper gives no total, and only TMAS and TUS arms (not sham) received ultrasound.
